sources.title: Free AI Checker: Does Your Writing Sound Like ChatGPT?
sources.snippet: Free, private AI checker. See which parts of your draft read like a machine, and fix each one. No sign-up, nothing leaves your browser.

sources.title: GitHub - stephenturner/skill-deslop: De-AI-ify scientific writing
sources.snippet: When you write, draft, edit, or review text, deslop identifies and eliminates predictable AI tells: formulaic sentence structures, filler phrases, false agency, dramatic fragmentation, vague declaratives, and dozens of other patterns that signal machine-generated writing. sources.title: Vincen AI
sources.snippet: Tell Vincen what you need — a pitch deck, a landing page, a market report, a promo video — and get back real, finished work.

sources.title: DeSlop - AI Slop Remover - Open VSX Registry
sources.snippet: DeSlop sends your selected prose to an AI model with a strict ruleset that bans the exact patterns AI models produce. It returns a rewrite and a structured list of every change made and why.

sources.title: Remove AI Slop from Writing | Deslop
sources.snippet: Remove AI slop from text, documents, and website copy. Deslop marks stock phrasing, repeated rhythms, and other common patterns.
